Champa rice(快熟耐旱,来自今Vietnam的 Champa King: Champa rice (fast-ripening and drought-resistant, from the Champa Kingdom in present-day Vietnam) · Two harvests yearly; rice could also grow in lowlands and hills · Khmer Empire (802–1431) irrigation and drainage enabled multiple annual rice harvests · chinampas (artificial raised fields built in the Lake Texcoco lake area, not floating farmland) · waru waru water-retaining ridges and channels and Andean terraces · three-field system, heavy plow, and windmills
Song Dynasty(960–1279) · imperial bureau: Song Dynasty (960–1279) · imperial bureaucracy (continuity since Qin, expanded under Song) · meritocracy and civil service examinations · Song Taizu opened educational opportunities to lower-class males · scholar-gentry numbers exceeded the hereditary aristocracy · Philip II (r. 1180–1223) built Europe’s first fully developed bureaucracy
sharia 让分裂后的Islamic各国仍共享同一套法律 · Seljuk 领: Sharia gave fragmented Islamic states a shared legal framework · Seljuk leaders called themselves sultans, reducing the caliph to the highest Sunni religious authority · Neo-Confucianism (developed and systematized under Song, with earlier intellectual precursors) and filial piety supported Song rule · Inca rulers claimed descent from Inti; the Aztec Great Speaker stood atop a theocracy · lay investiture controversy and Concordat of Worms (1122)
Tenochtitlan 1325 年建于湖心岛,人口近 200,000 · 修: Tenochtitlan, founded in 1325 on a lake island, had nearly 200,000 inhabitants · Aqueducts supplied water and drainage channels created farmland · Multiple Song cities exceeded 100,000 people; Hangzhou and Guangzhou were cosmopolitan centers · Nearly 20,000 people lived within Great Zimbabwe’s stone walls · European long-distance commerce fostered a middle class of bourgeoisie / burghers · House of Wisdom and Cordoba’s library, among the largest of the time
Indian Ocean trade 串起东非、中东、South Asia、东亚: Indian Ocean trade linked East Africa, the Middle East, South Asia, and East Asia · Dhows’ long, narrow hulls suited cargo rather than warfare · Swahili combined Bantu and Arabic elements · Kilwa, Mombasa, and Mogadishu exported gold from inland Zimbabwe · Trans-Saharan trade and Mansa Musa’s 1324 pilgrimage · Srivijaya (670–1025) and Majapahit (1293–1520) collected tolls by controlling sea routes
Mongol军队1258年攻陷Baghdad，终结当地Abbasid哈里发统治；: Mongol armies captured Baghdad in 1258, ending local Abbasid caliphal rule; different Seljuk successor states did not all end that year · Gunpowder spread west through the Mongols; firearms appeared in the Hundred Years’ War · Marco Polo reached Kublai Khan’s court at Dadu (present-day Beijing), encouraging cartography · The Delhi Sultanate resisted Mongol advances south · Song porcelain and silk production, Malian gold, and Kilwa’s ports were available in the same period
农业增产扩大了部分地区可供税收、城镇和非农业劳动使用的资源；这一条件有助于维持官: Higher agricultural output expanded resources available for taxation, towns, and nonagricultural labor in some regions, helping sustain bureaucracies. Neither surpluses nor states first appeared in 1200. The Song Dynasty example below shows how existing bureaucratic traditions continued and expanded.
统治者运用考试、教育、法律和宗教来组织行政与说明统治正当性。SongConfuc: Rulers used examinations, education, law, and religion to organize administration and justify rule. Song Confucian learning, Islamic law, and state religions in the Americas offer comparisons; no one country’s institutions were a universal stage for every region.
征税和征工需要地方组织、记录与执行能力。宗教合法性可能协助动员，但Inca劳役、: Tax and labor collection required local organization, records, and enforcement. Religious legitimacy could assist mobilization, but Inca labor service, Aztec tribute, and Song finances had distinct historical conditions. Fixed extraction did not inevitably follow religious unity.
交通、市场、国家需求和家庭劳动共同支持商品生产。Song雇工与货币使用可以作为一: Transport, markets, state demand, and household labor together supported commodity production. Song wage labor and money use provide one example; this does not mean all peasants entered markets for the first time under compulsion or other regions adopted the same fiscal institutions.
本地供给不足和对外商品需求支持区域贸易。西非黄金、东非港口与亚洲商品构成欧亚非联: Insufficient local supplies and demand for foreign goods supported regional trade. West African gold, East African ports, and Asian goods formed Afro-Eurasian connections. The Americas simultaneously had their own regional exchange networks, not yet connected to China’s porcelain trade.
法律、语言、商人社群、政治保护和港口设施都可能降低交易风险，作用随地区与时期而异: Law, languages, merchant communities, political protection, and port facilities could all reduce trading risks, with effects varying by region and period. The next link turns to political reorganization through Mongol expansion; Islamic contract institutions did not directly create the Mongol Empire.

稻田耘作：Illustrations of Tilling局部: Weeding rice fields: detail of Illustrations of Tilling
13 世纪China画：农人在稻田劳作，呈现稻作中的田间管理。: A 13th-century Chinese painting of farmers working in rice fields, showing field management in rice cultivation.
National Museum of Asian Art, Smithsonia: Illustrations of Tilling (after Lou Shou), attributed to Cheng Qi, mid-to-late 13th century, F1954.21, National Museum of Asian Art, Smithsonian Institution; museum image FS-8012_16. Used to compare rice-production activities, not an Angkor scene.
Khmer Empire统治者在Angkor组织水库、运河与劳动力，支持稻作农业: Khmer Empire rulers organized reservoirs, canals, and labor at Angkor to support rice farming. Agricultural surpluses provided resources for urban populations and nonagricultural activities.
civil-service examinations放榜：考生查看榜单: Civil-service examination results: candidates reading the list
MingViewing the Examination Results局部，以考: Detail of the Ming painting Viewing the Examination Results, using examination-based recruitment as an institutional reference.
Viewing the Examination Results局部，Ming，旧: Detail of Viewing the Examination Results, Ming, formerly attributed to Qiu Ying; attribution uncertain. Depicts candidates reading examination results. It is not an eyewitness image of Song Hangzhou and cannot establish every detail of Song examinations.
Song Dynasty依靠既有官僚传统、civil-service exami: The Song Dynasty organized rule through established bureaucratic traditions, civil-service examinations, and fiscal resources. The state needed sustained food supplies, taxes, and administrators; these institutions also supported economic activity.
1334 年Maqamat手稿插图：当事人向 qadi 陈述。: Illustration from a 1334 Maqamat manuscript: litigants address a qadi.
1334 年阿拉伯文学手稿插图，描绘 Abu Zayd 在 Ma’arra 法官: A 1334 Arabic literary manuscript illustration showing Abu Zayd addressing the judge of Ma’arra, held by the Austrian National Library. Used to understand legal practice, not a record of an actual Baghdad trial.
Islamic law、宗教学者与教育网络为统治和社会生活提供共同规则。这里与S: Islamic law, religious scholars, and educational networks provided shared rules for government and social life. Compared here with Song Confucian learning and other regions’ religious institutions.
记录官使用 quipu 结绳: A record keeper using quipu knots
约 1615 年追述性图像：用记录支撑资源管理。: A retrospective image from c. 1615: records supporting resource management.
Guaman Poma 约 1615 年绘制的Inca记录官，手持 quipu，: Guaman Poma’s c. 1615 depiction of an Inca record keeper holding a quipu; a yupana counting device appears at lower left. Reproduced here from a 1936 facsimile. Illustrates administrative records, not a direct record of a particular preconquest mit’a levy.
Inca国家通过地方社群征集 mit’a 劳役，修建道路及公共工程，并利用行政组: The Inca state collected mit’a labor through local communities for roads and public works, sustaining the empire through administrative organization and records. Regions extracted resources in different ways.
16th century 手稿中的物品贡赋记录。: A record of tribute goods in a 16th-century manuscript.
殖民早期对 Mexica 贡赋的追述记录，展示纺织品等资源义务；不是征服前某次征: An early-colonial retrospective record of Mexica tribute, showing obligations in textiles and other resources. Not an eyewitness image of a particular preconquest collection, nor proof that local rulers always cooperated willingly.
Kabir 与弟子的教学图像: A teaching image of Kabir and disciples
1825 年绘画，追述 Kabir 的虔敬教学传统。: An 1825 painting retrospectively depicting Kabir’s devotional teaching tradition.
晚于 U1 的后世图像，用于认识 Bhakti 传统的传播与历史记忆；不是 12: An image later than U1, used to understand the spread and historical memory of Bhakti traditions. Not a scene from Delhi in 1200–1450, nor evidence that Bhakti and Sufi traditions merged into one religion.
Timbuktu manuscript：书面学术的史料: Timbuktu manuscript: evidence of written scholarship
Library of Congress 收录的 Timbuktu 手稿页。: A Timbuktu manuscript page included in the Library of Congress collections.
用于观察 West Africa 的书面学术传统。具体手稿年代见原馆藏说明；不声: Used to examine West Africa’s written scholarly tradition. See the original collection description for the manuscript’s date. It is not claimed to be a fourteenth-century Malian classroom record, nor proof that griot oral traditions disappeared.
中世纪手稿中的收割劳动: Harvest labor in a medieval manuscript
c. 1310，Queen Mary’s Psalter 的农事图像。: An agricultural image from Queen Mary’s Psalter, c. 1310.
British Library Royal MS 2 B VII, f.78v；: British Library Royal MS 2 B VII, f.78v; depicts supervision and harvesting. A religious manuscript image is not a manor rent ledger; appearance alone cannot establish each person’s legal status.
British Library Cotton MS Augustus II.10: British Library Cotton MS Augustus II.106, one surviving 1215 text.
君主与贵族冲突和谈判的原始文书；不是签字仪式的照片，也不意味着它在 1215 年: An original document of conflict and negotiation between monarch and nobles, not a photograph of a signing ceremony. It did not grant equal rights to everyone in 1215.
bound-foot shoes：后期缠足鞋实物: Bound-foot shoes: a later surviving artifact
19th century，Brooklyn Museum 馆藏实物的照片。: A photograph of a 19th-century object in the Brooklyn Museum.
本件晚于 Song Dynasty，仅作为缠足习俗所涉及器物的参照；不能用 19: Later than the Song Dynasty, this object only provides a reference for material objects associated with foot binding. Nineteenth-century shoes cannot establish all Song details, prevalence, or every woman’s experience.
Islamic marriage contract：婚姻文书: Islamic marriage contract: a marriage document
后期 Iran 契约作为婚姻关系书面化的制度参照；不是 1200–1450 年: A later Iranian contract provides an institutional reference for written marriage arrangements. It is not an original from Baghdad in 1200–1450 and cannot independently establish every U1-era female property right or local enforcement practice.
1287 年纸币与木版；现代馆藏照片。: A banknote and wooden block from 1287; a modern museum photograph.
Tokyo Currency Museum 实物，反映 Yuan 统治下的财政与: Objects from Tokyo’s Currency Museum reflect fiscal and written institutions under Yuan rule. Not a scene of conquest in 1279, nor evidence that all Song social and economic traditions disappeared.
Mongol 围攻 Baghdad 的手稿图像: A manuscript image of the Mongol siege of Baghdad
后世手稿插图用于观察 Baghdad 围城的历史叙事，不是 1258 年现场记录: A later manuscript illustration used to examine historical narratives of Baghdad’s siege, not an eyewitness record from 1258. The end of local Abbasid rule did not mean the end of Islamic civilization.
Song Dynasty：civil-service examinations与: Song Dynasty: civil-service examinations and bureaucracy
Song Dynasty以Confucian education、考试及文官行政: The Song Dynasty organized government through Confucian education, examinations, and civil administration; family resources still shaped access to education and official careers.
Inca：mit’a 劳役与行政: Inca: mit’a labor service and administration
Inca通过 ayllu 社群动员轮换劳役，并以道路、仓储与记录协调国家活动。: The Inca mobilized rotating labor through ayllu communities, coordinating state activities with roads, storehouses, and records.
Khmer Empire：水利与农业动员: Khmer Empire: irrigation and agricultural mobilization
Angkor水库、渠道与劳动组织支持稻作及城市活动；水利与王权相互影响。: Angkor’s reservoirs, canals, and labor organization supported rice cultivation and urban activity; irrigation and royal power influenced each other.
Triple Alliance从被支配地区征收粮食、纺织品等贡赋，利用地方统治者: The Triple Alliance collected food, textiles, and other tribute from subordinate territories, relying on local rulers and tribute officials to sustain collection.
South Asia：Bhakti 与 Sufi 传统: South Asia: Bhakti and Sufi traditions
Bhakti 与 Sufi 传统重视个人虔敬，在South Asia形成接触和文: Bhakti and Sufi traditions emphasized personal devotion and interacted through cultural exchange in South Asia; they did not merge into one religion.
传播机制与地区比较: Mechanisms of transmission and regional comparison
U2：商人社群与宗教传播: U2: Merchant communities and religious transmission
比较商人、移民与宗教社群如何参与传播，同时保留各地的政治及文化差异。: Compare how merchants, migrants, and religious communities participated in transmission while retaining regional political and cultural differences.
South Asia、Mali与Malacca并非同一条连续传播路线。: South Asia, Mali, and Malacca were not one continuous route of transmission.
Mali：Islamic scholarship与口述传统: Mali: Islamic scholarship and oral traditions
Islamic学校和手稿学术扩大影响，griot 的口述历史与地方记忆仍保有社会: Islamic schools and manuscript scholarship expanded their influence, while griots’ oral histories and local memory retained social roles.
manor领主与农民围绕土地使用、地租及劳役建立义务关系；农村生产并不等于与市场: Manorial lords and peasants formed obligations around land use, rents, and labor service; rural production was not entirely isolated from markets.
England：君主与贵族的协商: England: negotiation between monarch and nobles
1215年Magna Carta来自君主与贵族的冲突和谈判，限制部分王权行为，主: Magna Carta in 1215 emerged from conflict and negotiation between monarch and nobles, limiting some royal actions and mainly protecting particular groups’ interests.
Song China：女性：地位规范与行动限制: Song China: women’s status norms and mobility restrictions
部分家庭的foot binding习俗与婚姻、地位和审美相连，并限制部分女性行动: Foot binding in some families was linked to marriage, status, and aesthetics, limiting some women’s mobility. Experiences across classes cannot be generalized.
Islamic societies：女性：财产权与家庭规范: Islamic societies: women’s property rights and family norms
法律传统承认女性拥有财产及通过婚资、继承取得资源；这些权利与父权家庭规范及地方习: Legal traditions recognized women’s property ownership and resources through marriage payments and inheritance. These rights coexisted with patriarchal family norms and local customs. Baghdad serves only as a regional location.
Southern Song：征服与政权更替: Southern Song: conquest and regime change
1271年Yuan Dynasty建立，1279年Southern Song D: The Yuan Dynasty was established in 1271; the Southern Song Dynasty ended in 1279. Comparison distinguishes regime collapse, social continuities, and institutional adjustments by new rulers.
U2：Mongol扩张如何改变区域政治？: U2: How did Mongol expansion change regional politics?
U1 比较两地政权的变化；U2 进一步解释Mongol扩张与征服。两个单元的时间: U1 compares changes in two political regimes; U2 further explains Mongol expansion and conquest. The units’ periods overlap; U1 did not happen first and U2 afterward.
两地同受Mongol扩张影响，但不代表Baghdad陷落导致Southern S: Both places were affected by Mongol expansion; this does not mean Baghdad’s fall caused the Southern Song Dynasty’s end.
Baghdad：征服与区域政治重组: Baghdad: conquest and regional political reorganization
1258年Mongol军队攻陷Baghdad，终结当地Abbasid统治。政治断: Mongol armies captured Baghdad in 1258, ending local Abbasid rule. Political rupture did not mean the disappearance of all regional cultural and social life.
不同国家怎样把地方社会纳入治理？: How did different states incorporate local societies into governance?
两者都依赖人员组织和信息，协调超出地方社群范围的国家活动。: Both relied on organized personnel and information to coordinate state activities beyond local communities.
Song Dynasty突出考试、Confucian scholar-offic: The Song Dynasty emphasized examinations, Confucian scholar-officials, and administration; the Inca emphasized community labor, roads, storage, and records.
制度的具体形式与资源、社会组织及治理传统有关；不能用是否有civil-servi: Specific institutional forms related to resources, social organization, and governing traditions. The presence of civil-service examinations cannot measure every state.
国家如何组织、取得维持统治的资源？: How did states organize and obtain resources to sustain rule?
两者都需要地方生产与组织能力，为城市及统治活动提供资源。: Both needed local production and organizational capacity to supply resources for cities and government.
Angkor案例突出水利和农业动员；Aztec案例突出被支配地区的贡赋征收及地方: Angkor emphasizes irrigation and agricultural mobilization; the Aztec case emphasizes tribute from subordinate territories and local intermediaries.
比较国家与地方之间的关系；水利管理和贡赋征收可并存，不应当成相互排斥的社会阶段。: Compare state-local relations. Irrigation management and tribute collection could coexist; they were not mutually exclusive social stages.
跨地区宗教如何与地方传统发生联系？: How did transregional religions connect with local traditions?
宗教传播扩大了交流，但没有让各地既有传统立即消失。: Religious transmission expanded exchange without immediately erasing existing local traditions.
South Asia的虔敬传统发生接触；Mali的Islamic书面学术与口述记: South Asian devotional traditions interacted; Islamic written scholarship and oral memory coexisted in Mali.
交流、选择与并存不都等于教义融合。比较时具体说明哪些实践改变、哪些传统延续。: Exchange, selection, and coexistence do not always mean doctrinal fusion. Specify which practices changed and which traditions continued.
劳动义务怎样被组织和执行？: How were labor obligations organized and enforced?
地方社群中的劳动与资源义务都能支持拥有权力的群体。: Labor and resource obligations within local communities could support powerful groups.
Europe案例以manor、土地使用和地租或劳役为中心；Inca通过社群轮换劳: The European case centers on manors, land use, rents, and labor service; the Inca used rotating community labor to support state activities.
应比较义务对象、身份、期限与用途，而不是说Europemanor发展成了Inca: Compare recipients, status, duration, and purposes of obligations, rather than claiming European manors developed into Inca mit’a.
征取劳动与征取产品有什么异同？: How did extraction of labor and products compare?
两国都从被纳入统治的社群获取资源，并依赖地方组织。: Both states obtained resources from incorporated communities and depended on local organization.
Inca案例强调轮换劳役；Aztec案例强调物品贡赋。两地实际汲取方式都不只有一: The Inca case emphasizes rotating labor, the Aztec case tribute goods. Both actually used more than one method of extraction.
把主导机制与全部制度区分开，不能写成Inca只有劳役、Aztec只有产品贡赋。: Distinguish the dominant mechanism from the full institutional system. The Inca did not extract only labor, nor the Aztec only products.
规范、习俗怎样影响女性的资源与行动？: How did norms and customs shape women’s resources and mobility?
女性经历均受家庭、地位与社会规范影响，不能用一项习俗代表所有女性。: Family, status, and social norms shaped women’s experiences; one custom cannot represent all women.
Song案例突出部分女性的身体与行动限制；Islamic societies案例: The Song case emphasizes bodily and mobility restrictions on some women; Islamic societies emphasize legal norms such as independent property ownership.
身体习俗与财产权属于不同维度，不能直接排出哪一社会女性整体更自由；还需比较阶层、: Bodily customs and property rights are different dimensions and cannot directly rank women’s overall freedom across societies. Class, enforcement, and everyday lives also require comparison.
中央统治如何依赖或约束地方精英？: How did central rule depend on or constrain local elites?
君主都依靠精英的合作，实际权力不能仅由统治者头衔判断。: Monarchs relied on elite cooperation; rulers’ titles alone cannot establish actual power.
Song Dynasty案例突出文官与考试；England案例突出君主与贵族的谈: The Song Dynasty case emphasizes civil officials and examinations; England emphasizes negotiation between monarch and nobles and some legal limits.
集权与分权不是完全有或完全无；Magna Carta保护特定群体，也不等于现代民: Centralization and decentralization were not all-or-nothing. Magna Carta protected particular groups and did not equal modern democracy.
征服如何结束旧政权，又带来哪些变化？: How did conquest end old regimes, and what changed?
Mongol扩张在两地都造成重大政治断裂。: Mongol expansion caused major political ruptures in both places.
1258年当地Abbasid统治结束；Yuan Dynasty1271年已建立，: Local Abbasid rule ended in 1258. The Yuan Dynasty was established in 1271 and completed conquest of the Southern Song Dynasty in 1279.
具体过程与结果不同；不能归为单一财政原因，也不能把政权灭亡写成文明消失。: Specific processes and outcomes differed. Neither can be reduced to one fiscal cause, nor regime collapse equated with civilization’s disappearance.
Song女性：家庭规范与foot binding: Song women: family norms and foot binding
Song部分家庭将foot binding与地位、婚姻及审美相联系，限制了部分女: Some Song families linked foot binding with status, marriage, and aesthetics, restricting some women’s mobility.
foot binding并非所有女性都采用；社会阶层、家庭资源及劳动方式会影响女: Not all women practiced foot binding. Social class, household resources, and forms of labor shaped women’s experiences.
原 U1 Gender Divergence 讲稿；AMSCO U1 Topic: Original U1 Gender Divergence teaching script; AMSCO U1 Topic 1.1; supplementary checking against the University of Missouri Museum of Anthropology.
Islamic societies女性：财产权与家庭规范: Women in Islamic societies: property rights and family norms
Islamic law传统承认女性可拥有财产，并通过婚资及继承取得资源。: Islamic legal traditions recognized women’s property ownership and resources through marriage payments and inheritance.
法律规范、地方习俗与实际执行并不完全相同；财产权不等于政治、婚姻或公共生活中的全: Legal norms, local customs, and actual enforcement differed; property rights did not mean full equality in politics, marriage, or public life.
原 U1 Gender Divergence 讲稿；教师整理，参照 Oxford: Original U1 Gender Divergence teaching script; teacher compilation referring to marriage and inheritance research in the Oxford Handbook of Islam and Women.
Southern Song Dynasty结束与Yuan Dynasty统治: The Southern Song Dynasty’s end and Yuan rule
Khubilai Khan在1271年宣布建立Yuan Dynasty；1279: Khubilai Khan proclaimed the Yuan Dynasty in 1271. Mongol conquest was completed in 1279, ending the Southern Song Dynasty.
新的统治者重新组织治理；政权更替不意味着既有社会、文化及行政知识全部消失。: New rulers reorganized governance; regime change did not erase all existing society, culture, or administrative knowledge.
教师整理；Smithsonian National Museum of Asia: Teacher compilation; Smithsonian National Museum of Asian Art, Yuan dynasty teaching resource.
Baghdad陷落与Abbasid统治结束: Baghdad’s fall and the end of Abbasid rule
Hülegü率Mongol军队于1258年攻陷Baghdad，终结当地Abbas: Hülegü led Mongol armies in capturing Baghdad in 1258, ending local Abbasid caliphal rule.
这一结果应放在Mongol扩张与区域政治变化中解释；不能只归因于城市维护费用，也: Explain this within Mongol expansion and regional political changes, rather than only urban maintenance costs or a supposed end to Islamic civilization.
原 U1 Why States Decline 讲稿，经 The Metropo: Original U1 Why States Decline teaching script, checked against The Metropolitan Museum of Art’s Ilkhanid-period feature; teacher compilation.
组织水利工程和公共劳动: Organizing irrigation works and public labor
与Inca比较：都需要组织劳动，但生态条件、行政方式和义务制度不同。: Compare with the Inca: both needed labor organization, but ecological conditions, administration, and obligation systems differed.
组织蓄水、渠道与劳动: Organize water storage, canals, and labor
为城市及公共活动提供资源: Provide resources for urban and public activities
水利管理可改善季节性供水，支持稻作；可动员的粮食与劳动又为城市和公共工程提供条件: Water management could improve seasonal supplies and support rice cultivation. Mobilizable food and labor in turn enabled cities and public works. This explains relationships within Khmer Empire society, not Khmer agriculture causing Song institutions.
水利、气候、地方组织与王权相互影响，不能把国家形成归为水利的单一结果。: Irrigation, climate, local organization, and royal power interacted; state formation cannot be reduced to irrigation alone.
农业怎样改变环境与人口？: How did agriculture change environments and populations?
U1 以Khmer Empire本地水利和稻作为例；U2 讨论作物跨区传播及其在: U1 uses local Khmer irrigation and rice cultivation; U2 examines crops spreading across regions and adoption in different environments. Production conditions and environmental effects can be compared.
不是“Khmer Empire水利导致作物传播”。目标卡的占城稻案例指Vietn: This does not mean “Khmer Empire irrigation caused crop diffusion.” The target card’s Champa rice example concerns transmission from Vietnam to China, before 1200.
civil-service examinations、Confucian edu: Civil-service examinations, Confucian education, and bureaucratic administration
与Islamic societies比较：学者和教育都能参与治理，但招募制度、法: Compare with Islamic societies: scholars and education could participate in governance in both, but recruitment systems, legal traditions, and sources of authority differed.
Confucian education与civil-service examin: Selection through Confucian education and civil-service examinations
为行政机构提供部分官员: Supply some officials to administrative institutions
把中央治理落实到地方事务: Implement central governance in local affairs
考试为官员选拔提供一条重要途径，教育与Confucian learning共同塑: Examinations offered an important recruitment route, while education and Confucian learning together shaped administrative elites. Fiscal and economic resources supported administration; administration, infrastructure, and markets also interacted.
Song官僚制度有更早的历史，考试也不是所有官员的唯一入仕途径；教育成本使不同家: Song bureaucracy had earlier historical roots, and examinations were not every official’s only route to office. Educational costs made opportunities unequal across families.
China商品进入印度洋网络: Chinese goods entered Indian Ocean networks
U1 的China商业与专业化生产为远距离交换提供商品。U2 的Kilwa案例包: U1’s Chinese commerce and specialized production supplied goods for long-distance exchange. U2’s Kilwa example includes imported Chinese porcelain, tracing how goods entered maritime networks.
这是China生产与贸易网络的联系，不是“Song Dynasty造成Kilwa: This connects Chinese production and trade networks; it does not mean “the Song Dynasty caused Kilwa’s rise.” Ports, merchants, demand, and political conditions also mattered.
Ming and Qing如何延续civil-service examinati: How did Ming and Qing continue civil-service examinations and civil-official traditions?
从Song官僚与Confucian education出发，追踪Ming and: Starting with Song bureaucracy and Confucian education, trace Ming and Qing use of examinations and scholar-official administration, comparing changes in recruitment and ruling structures.
其间经历元代统治及制度调整，不能画成没有中断和变化的直线，也不是Song Dyn: Yuan rule and institutional adjustments intervened. This was not an unbroken line without change, nor did Song institutions directly cause the Qing Dynasty’s establishment.
商人网络、知识与共同规范: Merchant networks, knowledge, and shared norms
法律实践、宗教学者与社群联系: Legal practice, religious scholars, and community connections
与Song Dynasty比较：共同知识与规范都参与社会组织；Islamic l: Compare with the Song Dynasty: shared knowledge and norms supported social organization in both; Islamic law and Song examinations were not the same institutional system.
共享法律传统与商人社群: Shared legal traditions and merchant communities
为部分交易提供规则与信任: Provide rules and trust for some transactions
支持商贸和跨地区社会联系: Support commerce and cross-regional social connections
商人与宗教学者参与维持法律、教育及社群联系；共同规则可以降低部分交易的不确定性。: Merchants and religious scholars helped sustain law, education, and community ties. Shared rules could reduce some transaction uncertainties. Political protection, language, port facilities, and local customs also mattered.
Islamic世界并不是统一国家，也不存在完全相同的法律实践；Baghdad只是: The Islamic world was not a unified state, nor were legal practices identical. Baghdad is only a learning anchor.
商人定居如何参与Islamic传播？: How did merchant settlement participate in the spread of Islam?
U1 先认识Islamic商人、规范和社群网络；U2 进一步考察Malacca港: U1 introduces Islamic merchants, norms, and community networks. U2 further examines how merchant residence, intermarriage, and community formation in Malacca participated in religious transmission.
这里追踪共享网络与传播机制，不表示所有商人来自Baghdad，也不是Islami: This traces shared networks and transmission mechanisms, not all merchants originating in Baghdad or Islamic law automatically causing local conversion.
Inca：劳役与行政记录: Inca: labor service and administrative records
ayllu 社群提供的轮换劳役: Rotating labor supplied by ayllu communities
劳役义务、道路、仓储与记录: Labor obligations, roads, storage, and records
与Khmer Empire比较：都把劳动投入公共活动；Inca mit’a 与K: Compare with the Khmer Empire: both used labor for public activities; Inca mit’a and Khmer labor organization cannot be directly equated.
国家通过 ayllu 社群组织义务: The state organized obligations through ayllu communities
为公共工程和国家活动提供劳力: Supply labor for public works and state activities
以社群为基础的义务使国家能够动员劳动。道路、仓储与结绳记录帮助协调行政；它们支持: Community-based obligations enabled state labor mobilization. Roads, storage, and knotted records helped coordinate administration and sustain the empire; this did not mean no tribute or other resource collection existed.
制度具有强制性，不能写成完全自愿的互助，也不能与后来的殖民采矿征役混为一谈。: The institution was coercive, not entirely voluntary mutual aid, and must not be conflated with later colonial mining drafts.
殖民 mit’a 如何被改造成矿业征役？: How was colonial mit’a transformed into a mining labor draft?
西班牙殖民统治借用了安第斯轮换劳动义务，并在1573年Toledo改革中组织矿业: Spanish colonial rule adapted Andean rotating labor obligations, organizing mining drafts through Toledo’s 1573 reforms. Compare continuities in institutional names and obligations with changes in purposes, beneficiaries, and coercive conditions.
这是征服与殖民国家改造旧制度的过程，不是“Inca劳役自然发展成殖民剥削”。: This was conquest and colonial state transformation of old institutions, not “Inca labor naturally developing into colonial exploitation.”
国家如何把地方劳动转化为公共资源？: How did states turn local labor into public resources?
Khmer Empire与Inca都依靠组织劳动支持公共工程和国家活动。: The Khmer Empire and Inca both relied on organized labor for public works and state activities.
Angkor案例突出适应季节性供水的水利与稻作；Inca案例突出通过 ayllu: Angkor emphasizes irrigation and rice farming adapted to seasonal water supplies. The Inca emphasizes rotating mit’a through ayllu communities, coordinating administration through roads, storage, and records.
两者可以比较资源动员，但Khmer Empire水利管理与Inca劳役制度的行政: Both illustrate resource mobilization, but Khmer irrigation management and Inca labor systems differed in administrative units, ecology, and obligation arrangements; they were not one institution.
水库、渠道及公共劳动支持Angkor稻作与城市活动。: Reservoirs, canals, and public labor supported Angkor’s rice cultivation and urban activities.
ayllu 社群承担轮换劳役；道路、仓储与 quipu 协助组织国家活动。: Ayllu communities supplied rotating labor; roads, storage, and quipu helped organize state activities.
知识、学者与规范怎样参与治理？: How did knowledge, scholars, and norms participate in governance?
Song Dynasty与Islamic societies都运用知识、教育和共: The Song Dynasty and Islamic societies both used knowledge, education, and shared norms to organize social life.
Song Dynasty案例突出civil-service examinatio: The Song case emphasizes recruiting some civil officials through examinations and administering through Confucian learning. Islamic societies emphasize religious scholars, legal practice, and merchant-community networks operating across multiple regimes.
一个侧重国家官员招募，另一个侧重法律与社群联系；这不是“civil-servic: One centers on recruiting state officials, the other on legal and community ties. Civil-service examinations did not equal Islamic law, nor did all Islamic regions use the same governance.
Confucian education与考试为官员选拔提供重要途径，形成士大夫行: Confucian education and examinations provided important recruitment routes, forming traditions of scholar-official administration.
宗教学者与商人参与法律、教育及社群联系，共同规范为部分交易提供规则与信任。: Religious scholars and merchants participated in law, education, and community ties; shared norms provided rules and trust for some transactions.
Columbian Exchange：征服后的大西洋世界: Columbian Exchange: the postconquest Atlantic world
在 U4 中，把殖民劳役放回征服后的大西洋背景，同时区分人员、作物、动物与疾病的: In U4, place colonial labor within the postconquest Atlantic context while distinguishing transoceanic movements of people, crops, animals, and diseases.
殖民 mit’a 属于劳动制度的改造；Columbian Exchange 主要: Colonial mit’a involved transformation of a labor institution; the Columbian Exchange primarily concerns biological and population exchanges. They were related but distinct processes.
从 Montpellier 到 Barcelona 的汇票: A bill of exchange from Montpellier to Barcelona
Datini 商号相关的支付与背书文书。: Payment and endorsement documents associated with the Datini firm.
Archivio di Stato di Prato, Datini, bust: Archivio di Stato di Prato, Datini, busta 1145/2, cod.1403471. An image of an original European bill of exchange, not Chinese flying cash. For local teaching preview only; the source does not explicitly grant open republication rights.

File:男人理髮稱作“剃頭”是從清朝開始的，剃頭顱前的頭髮，腦後留辮子以示歸順: File:Qing-era head shaving and queues as signs of submission, itinerant barber carrying tools on a shoulder pole - Sohu.jpg
monsoon 的可预期性与船舶、航海经验共同支持跨海载货；沿岸及内地的商品需求: Predictable monsoons, vessels, and navigational experience together supported maritime cargo transport. Demand for coastal and inland goods turned transport into actual exchange. These conditions operated in parallel; step 1 did not cause step 2.
货物与商人汇入港口，增加补给、配货与转运需求，支持港口服务发展。: Goods and merchants converging on ports increased demand for provisioning, cargo consolidation, and transshipment, supporting port services.
这里换用 Malacca 说明统治者如何把集中的商业活动转为收费与收入。是同一机: Malacca now illustrates how rulers turned concentrated commerce into fees and revenue. This is a succession of examples of the same mechanism, not Kilwa causing Malacca’s rise.
港口收入提供经费；统治者将其中一部分投入海军与防 piracy，收入才转化为保护: Port revenue provided funding. Only when rulers invested some in naval forces and antipiracy measures did income become protective capacity.
保护有效运作时，有助于减少部分劫掠损失和不确定性；战争与政策仍会影响商人。: Effective protection helped reduce some plunder losses and uncertainty; war and policy still affected merchants.
需求与航路仍在时，风险有所降低和服务改善有助于商人继续往来。: Where demand and routes persisted, lower risks and better services helped merchants continue trading.
持续往来又把商品带入港口市场，可能扩大交易和收入，回到第 3 环。这是增长反馈，: Continued traffic brought goods back into port markets, potentially expanding trade and revenue and returning to step 3. This is growth feedback, without guaranteeing endless continuation.
人员流动和跨地区接触提供传播机会；是否扩散及死亡规模，还取决于病原、宿主、病媒和: Human movement and cross-regional contact offered transmission opportunities. Spread and death tolls also depended on pathogens, hosts, vectors, and ecological conditions.
严重人口损失减少部分地区的劳动力供给，改变幸存劳动者的议价条件；法律、土地制度与: Severe population losses reduced labor supplies in some areas, changing surviving workers’ bargaining conditions. Laws, land systems, and elite responses shaped outcomes.
远程携款的重量、成本与风险，形成减少现钱搬运的需求。flying cash 和: The weight, cost, and risks of carrying money over distances generated demand to reduce cash transport. Flying cash and bills of exchange were distinct responses in different regions, not upgrades of the same instrument.
汇兑与汇票各自能替代部分现钱搬运，便利远程结算；作用都依赖参与者接受及支付方能够: Remittance arrangements and bills of exchange could each replace some cash transport and ease long-distance settlement. Both depended on acceptance and payers’ ability to honor them; using both together was unnecessary.
港口停留延长接触时间；往来反复发生时，部分短期交往能成为持续的人际关系。: Port stays extended contact. Repeated traffic could turn some short-term interactions into sustained personal relationships.
持续关系为定居、通婚与家庭形成提供条件；是否迁居仍受商机、家庭与当地环境影响。: Sustained relationships enabled settlement, intermarriage, and family formation. Relocation still depended on business opportunities, families, and local conditions.
家庭、商业和宗教联系使跨文化接触进入日常生活，支持语言借用与信仰传播；当地居民也: Family, commercial, and religious ties brought intercultural contact into daily life, supporting linguistic borrowing and religious transmission; local people also selected and adapted.
新品种传入扩大可选作物；只有被采用并适应本地条件后，较短生长期才可能改变种植安排: Introduced varieties expanded crop choices. Only after adoption and adaptation to local conditions could shorter growing periods change cultivation schedules.
较短生长期在条件适宜时允许灵活复种，配合水利与劳动投入，有助于增加年度粮食产出。: Under suitable conditions, shorter growing periods allowed flexible multiple cropping. Combined with irrigation and labor inputs, they could increase annual food output.
更多可用粮食能供养人口和城镇劳动者，是支持条件；市场、政治与基础设施也影响增长。: More available food could sustain populations and urban workers as a supporting condition; markets, politics, and infrastructure also shaped growth.
征服扩大领地与人口，产生持续征税、通信和行政的需要；单靠军事威慑不能完成日常治理: Conquest expanded territory and population, creating needs for continuing taxation, communication, and administration. Military intimidation alone could not accomplish everyday governance.
熟悉文书、财赋和地方情况的人才，使人口管理和资源征取更可操作；任用人才本身不保证: People familiar with documents, revenue, and local conditions made population management and resource collection more feasible. Appointing skilled personnel alone did not guarantee legitimacy.
可调配资源为驿传、通信和部分商路保护提供物质条件；投入和实际成效取决于统治选择与: Available resources provided material conditions for postal relays, communication, and some trade-route protection. Investment and actual results depended on ruling choices and political conditions.
